meta.title: Fredlund & Krahn (1977), rᵤ = 0.25
meta.notes: The V044 slope and circle with a pore pressure ratio rᵤ = 0.25 (Fredlund & Krahn's case 3).

source.reference: Fredlund, D.G. & Krahn, J. (1977). Comparison of slope stability methods of analysis. Can. Geotech. J. 14(3), 429–439.
source.derived_from: cSlope verification problem V044b (MIT License), https://github.com/ZilanCiftci/cslope
notes: Fredlund & Krahn (1977), Table 2 case 3 ("Same as 1 except with ru = 0.25"): ordinary 1.607, Bishop 1.766, Spencer 1.761 (θ = 14.33°, λ = 0.255), Janbu simplified 1.735, Janbu rigorous 1.708, Morgenstern-Price constant 1.765 (λ = 0.244); Table 3: constant 1.772 and half-sine 1.770 (Alberta), constant 1.765, half-sine 1.764 and clipped sine 1.779 (Saskatchewan). Read from the paper's page images (docs/kallor/fredlund-krahn-1977.md).

Their rᵤ is the pore pressure over the vertical stress of the soil above the base, as cSlope's. Commercial program A (verification problem 21): Bishop 1.763, Spencer 1.760, M-P (half-sine) 1.760, ordinary 1.687.
